name: Nordstrom Rack

prices.note: Like-for-like item: women's jeans. A sample, not the whole range: 119 jeans from page 1 (default sort) and page 42 of the Women's Jeans & Denim listing (2,961–3,069 items that day, 42–43 pages); the price-sort URLs returned an empty page to WebFetch. 'Regular price' = Nordstrom Rack's listed selling price ('Comparable value' shown as reference); excluded items labeled 'New Markdown', 'Previous Price' or a promo range ('Up to 60% off select items'), and non-jeans (denim shorts, a shirtdress, culottes, pants). Min: MANGO Claudia Waxed Crop Slim Fit Jeans $15.38 (comparable $69.99); max: Akris Finnian High Waist Wide Leg Jeans $419.97 (comparable $995). Page-1 items ran $39.97–$79.97. Brands seen include Levi's, Democracy, Joe's, Good American, Madewell, True Religion, Lucky Brand, PAIGE, FRAME, Citizens of Humanity, L'AGENCE, AG, rag & bone, Veronica Beard.

sale_pattern: Ongoing markdowns: homepage banner 'New Markdowns Up to 70% Off'; a Clearance department in the main navigation.

Shipping/returns page (2026-10-29): free shipping 'Applies to most orders over $89 before tax'; 'All other orders under $89: $9.95'; 'Online purchases must be returned within 40 days of order date'; '$9.95 will be deducted from your refund per pre-paid shipping label used'; online orders can be returned to any Nordstrom or Nordstrom Rack store at no charge; 'Nordstrom Rack will no longer offer shipping options for addresses outside of the U.S., including Canada.' Holiday extension for purchases 10/5/26–12/24/26 runs to 1/18/27.
Size range from the jeans listing's size filters (women's 00 to 28W+/4X+, petite 00 (XXS) to 18+ (XXL+), plus 14W–28W+/1X–4X+, waist 23–36).

Wikipedia (Nordstrom_Rack): founded 1973 in Seattle as a clearance outlet [3], first Rack in the basement of the downtown Seattle Nordstrom [4]; parent Nordstrom; HQ Seattle; 348 stores in 41 US states [2] (infobox says 346, 2023). HauteLook (acquired by Nordstrom 2011) now redirects to nordstromrack.com/events.
nordstromrack.com serves a JavaScript challenge to curl; read only via WebFetch. Query-string URLs (sort) came back empty; ?page=N worked.
